public_rationale: The review exists: 'Large Language Model Reasoning Failures' by Song, Han and Goodman, submitted to arXiv on 5 February 2026. Its authors are at Caltech, Stanford and Carleton College. Its abstract says 'significant reasoning failures persist,' even in simple scenarios. It also says reasoning-branded models such as o1-mini remain 'brittle under simple perturbations,' and that some tasks challenge 'state-of-the-art large reasoning models.' So it does document major reasoning problems that extend to reasoning models. One caveat: it is a survey of earlier studies, many on older models, so its coverage of the very latest systems is partial.
limitations: Survey of prior literature, not new tests of the newest models.
One of three authors is at Carleton College, not Caltech or Stanford.
The paper also acknowledges 'remarkable reasoning capabilities.'

public_payload.normalized_proposition: The latest deep learning systems, including those marketed as reasoning models, still have major problems with reasoning, as a Caltech/Stanford review shows.
conditions: even systems marketed as reasoning systems

statement.excerpt: A new review from Caltech and Stanford, called Large Language Model Reasoning Failure shows the latest deep learning systems — even the ones marketed as “reasoning” systems — (still) have major problems with reasoning.
statement.document_title: BREAKING: LLM “reasoning” continues to be deeply flawed

our_interpretation: Plain reading: a recent review with Caltech and Stanford authors exists, and it documents substantial reasoning failures in recent LLMs, including dedicated reasoning models (e.g., o1-series, large reasoning models).
Minor title variance ('Failure' vs 'Failures') is not material.
criteria.support_condition: The review exists, has Caltech and Stanford affiliations, is recent, and reports significant reasoning failures that extend to reasoning-branded models.
criteria.contradiction_condition: The review does not exist or lacks those affiliations, or it finds that recent reasoning models do not have significant reasoning problems.
